video.title: What Your CGM Actually Tells You
video.script: You've been wearing a glucose monitor for weeks. It tracks your blood sugar all day, every day. But then what. You get numbers you don't understand. Meals that might spike you. Patterns buried in data. Glucose Decoder changes that. Paste a week of your CGM readings, and it shows you exactly which meals hit you hardest, what your glucose actually does, and four changes that would move your numbers. Free, runs right in your browser. Link in the description.
